messages.content: List three sounds you might hear in a village at dawn. Number them and use no more than four words per item.

1. Roosters crowing loudly
2. Temple bells ringing
3. Cows lowing in sheds
Help me decline a dinner invitation politely, in under 25 words, without using the word "no".
Thank you so much for inviting me. I have a family function that evening, but I hope we can meet soon.
Name three things that are usually round, one per line, without using the word "ball".

Coin
Plate
Wheel
Give me the opening line of a bedtime story in exactly ten words, and include the word "dragon".
Once a gentle dragon lived behind the old school wall.
Write a postcard message from Jaipur in exactly three sentences, and include the word "palace".
Greetings from Jaipur! The pink palace walls glow in the evening light. I wish you were here.
List the first four colours of the rainbow, starting with red, comma-separated and all lowercase.
red, orange, yellow, green
Name four vegetables, one per line, and make sure no two of them start with the same letter.

Carrot
Okra
Potato
Spinach
Write four lines about a waterfall whose first letters spell FALL.

Foam leaps from the cliff
All the rocks are slick and bright
Loud water sings on
Light turns into rainbows
Think of a recipe name with exactly three words, one of them "spicy", in title case.
Spicy Potato Curry
Give one tip for a beginner at chess in a sentence of at most twelve words.
Control the centre of the board with your pawns early.
List three things to check before a long train journey, each beginning with the word "Check", one per line.

Check your ticket.
Check the platform number.
Check your bag before leaving.
Three quick breakfast ideas as a numbered list, no item longer than three words.

1. Poha with peanuts
2. Fruit and curd
3. Vegetable upma
What is khichdi? Say it in one sentence of at most 15 words that includes the word "khichdi".
Khichdi is a simple dish of rice and lentils cooked together until soft.
How can I wish someone a safe trip? Two options, one per line, each under seven words.

Have a safe journey.
Travel safely, and message me later.
Name three spices used in Indian cooking, one per line, each with a capital first letter.

Turmeric
Cumin
Cardamom
Describe a bedroom in two sentences, mentioning a "bed" and a "lamp".
There is a small bed under the window. A yellow lamp stands on the table beside it.
Name five vegetables for a kitchen garden, on one line, separated by commas, in alphabetical order.
beans, brinjal, carrot, okra, tomato
Tell a two-sentence bedtime story about a sleepy bear. The word "cave" must be in the second sentence.
A sleepy bear walked slowly through the snowy forest. At last she found a warm cave and curled up for the winter.
Describe a bus stop in exactly twenty words.
The bus stop stands under a neem tree, where people wait with bags and umbrellas while the busy road hums.
Name one thing found in each of these places, as "place: thing" lines: kitchen, garden, library.

kitchen: spoon
garden: spade
library: book
